title: Global dimension bound for localized fibres
statement: Let R → S be a finite type map of commutative rings and g ∈ S. If every prime q in D(g) has local fibre dimension at most d, then every nonempty fibre of S_g has Krull dimension at most d.

source.place: Tags 00DK, 00DL and 00E4, used in Tag 00ST proof (3)

proof.text: Identify each localized fibre with the principal open D(g ⊗ 1) in the original fibre using tensor localization base change and the affine-spectrum localization homeomorphism; transfer local bounds via the fibre-prime order isomorphism and apply the supremum formula for Krull dimension.

lean.statement: theorem localized_fibre_dimension_le_of_basicOpen {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [FiniteType R S] (g : S) (d : ℕ) (hV : ∀ q' : PrimeSpectrum S, q' ∈ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g → topologicalKrullDimAt (PrimeSpectrum.preimageEquivFiber R S (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S) q') ⟨q', rfl⟩) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) : ∀ p' : PrimeSpectrum R, Nontrivial (p'.asIdeal.Fiber (Localization.Away g)) → topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (p'.asIdeal.Fiber (Localization.Away g))) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
